privacy.countsModel: Browser requests counted per monitored context. Separate SSR/header/API probes are stated separately, not silently added. No external video played.

dataSafety.validation: Owning schemas and relationships before canonical writes; duplicate/future/non-finite/malformed/oversized rejection; no unknown-to-zero coercion.
dataSafety.backup: Counts/manifest/SHA-256/bounded files; no active-workout pointer; portable excludes binary photos; unencrypted and unauthenticated.
dataSafety.restore: Fresh-profile preparation, zero-write preview, invalid-import preservation, keep-existing preference preservation, partial failure transaction abort and automatic before-image rollback; retained recovery; no global atomicity.
dataSafety.csv: Safe default neutralizes = + - @ TAB CR; commas/quotes/CRLF/multiline/Unicode/empty values and date serialization reviewed; raw mode labelled.
dataSafety.media: JPEG/PNG/WebP MIME+signature; 10 MiB/20 MP bounds; corrupt decoding rejection; local canvas sanitization and metadata checks; checksum/dimensions/manifest; full-media JSON restore; no upload.

healthSafety.diet: Adult eligibility, pregnancy/lactation exclusion, consent, disclosed formulas, conservative bounds; no future-weight guarantee or auto calorie credit.
healthSafety.body: BMI context; only externally measured/source-labelled body composition; no fabricated body-fat or score.
healthSafety.sleep: Source-labelled estimates; no diagnosis, fabricated stages or certain sleep-debt claim.
healthSafety.recovery: Soreness distinct from pain/illness; stop guidance; no opaque score.
healthSafety.cardio: Manual/source-labelled estimates and stop signals; no fake VO2max/fitness age/universal Zone 2/calorie burn.
healthSafety.supplements: Provenance/evidence and unknown blends preserved; adverse-event guidance; no prescribing/steroid/SARM/peptide protocols/global efficacy or safety scores.
